name: claude-skills
description: Small, composable Claude Code plugins: a two-command spec-then-build pipeline, an adversarial advisory council, and a game save-file reverse-engineering method.

plugins.name: big
plugins.description: One command for a large piece of work: interview as a design tree, write a plan into the repo, execute it through executor subagents in parallel waves with a commit per task, then loop the review until clean. Resumable across sessions - the plan file carries per-task state.

plugins.name: engineering-kit
plugins.description: Six model-invoked engineering disciplines the agent reaches for on its own: diagnosing-bugs, tdd, research, domain-modeling, codebase-design, resolving-merge-conflicts. Pairs with the big plugin, which uses them when they are installed. Derived from Matt Pocock's skills repository under MIT - see the plugin's NOTICE.

plugins.name: spec-build
plugins.description: A two-command build workflow. /spec-it interviews you until the design tree is settled and writes a self-contained plan file; /build-it reads that plan and dispatches planner and executor subagents wave by wave, then reviews the result. Ships the planner and executor agents it needs.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Convene five advisors with deliberately opposed lenses (Architect, Skeptic, Pragmatist, Researcher, Contrarian), have them peer-review each other anonymously, force a debate round when the agreement looks like groupthink, and deliver a verdict that preserves the minority view. For decisions that are expensive to reverse.

plugins.name: game-save-re
plugins.description: A method for reverse-engineering and patching game save files: identify the container format, locate the field, re-sign checksums and length prefixes, and verify in-game. Engine-agnostic (Unity, Godot, Ren'Py, RPG Maker, custom binary).
